title: Volumology Labs

hero.headline: Map the volume through the boundaries that organize it.
hero.support: A recovered historical landing page for the geometry and physics research lane that explored regions, surfaces, flows, projection, closure, and defect as a route into larger boundary-first formalism.

sections.heading: Region before coordinate
sections.body: Start by identifying the region, its boundary, what crosses it, and what remains invariant before choosing a preferred coordinate description.

sections.heading: Surface and volume together
sections.body: Volume behavior and boundary behavior are treated as coupled representations rather than unrelated scales.

sections.heading: Projection as instrument
sections.body: Surface, shell, and volume projections can expose structure hidden by an undifferentiated interior description.

sections.heading: From historical lane to current method
sections.body: The durable operational idea has been retained as Volumetric Mapping inside the broader Boundary First research program.

notes: Recovered from the earlier eight-page landing-page set.
